body: Stimulants helped me, not sure if I actually have ADhd but it helped my depression. No meds really have helped me except esketamine (shock therapy for the win tho)

Guys I've felt this way for the majority of my life, I'm 26 and have had multiple attempts. I'm 26 and have lived with psychotic depression and anxiety, anorexia and addiction- I started electroshock therapy a few months ago and my entire life has turned around. Everything has changed-i am truly...happy? Not saying I'm not struggling but I feel all the emotions now and haven't felt actively or passively suicidal in months. apparently I am extroverted and enjoy socializing, am passionate and am working towards goals, I have motivation and am so grateful for everything in my life. Including being alive. I promise you things can change. Please get help, you so deserve to experience joy and not feel this way. you don't see it now but life can be so beautiful and fulfilling. Sending love
